# understudy

> A Claude Code plugin that stands in for a user, drives a live web product in a real browser, and reports back through a chosen lens. Every finding cites a screenshot. It never handles a credential and never uploads anything.

understudy answers evaluative questions about a web product or website by separating three things: the target (never in the repo), the traversal (how evidence is gathered — one browser session), and the lens (how that evidence is scored — usability, bugs, onboarding, content, clarity, conversion, trust, icp, technical, SEO, AEO, compare). One traversal, many scorings.

The icp lens derives three ideal customer profiles (primary, expansion, next-best) from the captured evidence, each scored on fit and propensity, each with the case against it, the trap segment named, and a re-run persona — no market research. Reports render as a PDF and as a self-contained interactive HTML (dashboard, findings explorer, per-persona session replay, Present mode, triage with export).

Its published reproducibility floor: scoring identical evidence twice reproduces about 30% of individual findings and 43% of the serious ones. Themes are stable; single findings are one careful reading.

## Docs

- [Landing page](https://dariobianchi00.github.io/understudy/): what it is, the two rules that keep findings honest, install
- [README](https://github.com/dariobianchi00/understudy#readme): full documentation — lenses, models, personas, verification, run-over-run diffing
- [Source](https://github.com/dariobianchi00/understudy): MIT-licensed plugin marketplace

## Install

- `/plugin marketplace add dariobianchi00/understudy` then `/plugin install understudy` in Claude Code; requires Playwright MCP
